title: reverse_tunnel: deferred-delete handshake wrappers on listener stop

target.summary: `resetFileEvents()` explicitly calls `connection->close(Network::ConnectionCloseType::NoFlush)` on open handshake connections before invoking `wrapper->shutdown()`, which itself closes the connection. This causes the connection to be closed twice during listener teardown.
notes: redundantly closes the connection before wrapper->shutdown() is called
